_comment: BUCKET RESOURCE POLICY — the floor under every identity policy.
An identity policy says what a role may do. This says what the BUCKET accepts,
whoever is asking. Both denials below apply to the account root user and to any
future role someone attaches in a hurry.
Terraform (templatefile). admin_principals is a JSON array of the ARNs of the
authorised human administrators — AT LEAST TWO, named by the owner. This
repository does not name them: an invented administrator is worse than a
missing one, because it looks like a decision that was made.

_why: GOVERNANCE mode exists so a mistake made while the process is new can be
corrected. That correction is an administrative act by a named human, never
something a workflow can reach. Under COMPLIANCE mode this statement is
moot — nobody can bypass, including these principals and the account root.
